title: あめふり (Amefuri — It's Raining)
description: A charming 1925 rainy-day song by the lyricist Kitahara Hakushu. A child's mother comes to meet them in the rain carrying a janome umbrella (the traditional black-and-white ringed paper umbrella). The child's generous impulse — lending their own umbrella to a wet stranger — and the familiar refrain 'pitch-pitch, chap-chap, ran-ran-ran' have made this one of Japan's most beloved rainy season songs.
